svg.text: ENTERPRISE RAG KNOWLEDGE LIFECYCLE, NLI CONTRADICTION & SUPERSESSION ARCHITECTURE
Stop 24.6% Stale Answers: Ingestion NLI Gate + superseded_by Chain + Temporal Filter
500K Docs / 3M Queries/Mo: Tier 1 Append-Only Dump (24.6% Stale) vs. Tier 2 Time-Decay vs. Tier 4 Ingestion NLI + Temporal Filter (0.3% Stale)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Append-Only Dump & Naive Decay
1. Append-Only Vector Dump (Tier 1: 24.6% Stale Answers):
• 2023 Refund Policy (30 days) and 2026 Policy (14 days) both sit in Top-5;
• LLM cites obsolete rules or blends them into a Frankenstein hallucination
2. Naive Recency Time-Decay Multiplier (Tier 2: 68.5% Evergreen Recall):
• Blindly penalizing older timestamps buries valid 2022 foundational legal
statutes & core architecture docs behind noisy 2026 Slack/Wiki notes!
3. Query-Time Frontier LLM Arbitrator (Tier 3: +1,850ms Latency):
• Paying GPT-4o on every query to guess which chunk is authoritative
Production Failure Impact (500K Docs / 3M Queries/Mo):
• Stale / Contradictory Answer Rate: 24.6% (Tier 1) | 11.4% (Tier 2)
• Evergreen Foundational Recall: Drops to 68.5% under naive time-decay
• Monthly Compliance & Re-Work Cost: $185,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Ingestion NLI Gate + superseded_by + Temporal Filter
1. Canonical doc_family_id & Atomic superseded_by Chain:
• Ingesting Policy v2026 atomically sets v2023 is_latest=false & effective_to;
• Default query pre-filter (WHERE is_latest=true) drops v2023 in 2.0ms!
2. Pre-Ingestion Top-15 DeBERTa-v3 NLI Contradiction Scanner:
• Scans nearest active chunks across departments on write; catches 98.5%
of conflicting numbers/rules & applies Authority Rank (Legal > Wiki)
3. Doc-Class TTL Tiering (Evergreen vs. Ephemeral Campaign TTL):
• Evergreen policies keep 98.8% recall with 180-day steward review SLA
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Stale / Contradictory Answer Rate: 0.3% (-24.3 pts vs. Tier 1)
• Ingestion Conflict Catch: 98.5% | Evergreen Recall: 98.8% (+2ms filter)
• Monthly Governance TCO: $22,000 / mo (-88.1% savings vs. Tier 1)
